aboutSubheading: Proudly servicing Melbourne's south-east for over 15 years
aboutText: With over 15 years of hands-on experience serving Melbourne's south-eastern suburbs, VIP Fencing & Home Maintenance has built a strong reputation for quality craftsmanship and dependable service. From our base in Dandenong South, our licensed and insured team handles everything from new timber and Colorbond fencing to complete home maintenance, deck builds, and gate installations. We're locally owned, family-run, and committed to getting the job done right the first time.

servicesSubheading: From fencing to full property maintenance — we do it all
servicesText: Whether you need a brand-new fence, a quick repair, or ongoing home maintenance, our skilled tradesmen deliver quality results every time. All work is fully insured and backed by our satisfaction guarantee.

services.title: Timber Fencing Installation
services.desc: Classic timber paling, treated pine, and hardwood fencing installed to your specifications. We handle everything from posts and rails to capping and finishing — built to withstand Melbourne's weather for years to come.

services.title: Colorbond Fencing
services.desc: Low-maintenance, durable Colorbond fencing in a wide range of colours. Perfect for privacy, noise reduction, and a clean modern look that complements any home or commercial property.

services.title: Fence Repairs & Restoration
services.desc: Leaning posts, broken palings, storm damage, or general wear and tear — we'll get your fence looking and functioning like new again. Fast turnaround and competitive rates.

services.title: Gate & Hardware Installation
services.desc: Swing gates, sliding gates, pedestrian gates, and automated entry systems. We supply and install quality hardware with professional fitting for smooth, reliable operation.

services.title: Deck & Pergola Construction
services.desc: Custom timber decks and pergolas designed for your lifestyle and budget. From a simple platform deck to an entertainer's dream with built-in seating and lighting — we build it all.

services.title: General Home Maintenance
services.desc: Handyman services including painting, gutter cleaning, small repairs, and property upkeep. Keep your home in top shape with our reliable maintenance team on call.

bannerSubheading: Get a free, no-obligation quote on fencing or home maintenance today. We service all of Melbourne's south-eastern suburbs.
testimonialsSubheading: Real feedback from real homeowners across Melbourne

testimonials.text: The team at VIP did a ripper job on our new Colorbond fence. Was quoted two weeks but they had it knocked over in three days. Clean, tidy, and the missus is wrapped with how it looks. Would happily recommend to anyone in the area.
testimonials.name: Dave Mitchell

testimonials.text: We had a storm take out half our back fence and VIP was the only mob who could get out the same week. They replaced the damaged section with matching timber palings and you can't even tell it was repaired. Fair price and very professional.
testimonials.name: Sarah Nguyen

testimonials.text: Used VIP for a new deck and pergola out the back — absolute game changer for our outdoor entertaining. The tradies were punctual, cleaned up after themselves every day, and the finished product is even better than we imagined. Already had the neighbours asking who did it!
testimonials.name: Mick Patterson
